rows.title: A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own pages, saved, listed, changed and used to start a germinal products notification
rows.detail: Template creation offers Germinal products alongside Live animals, because a template carries its type and the service that stores templates holds both animals sets. A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own question pages in template mode — the same template mode the live animals pages use, applied to the germinal pages, never a copied template journey — so it has no Additional details task and asks no CPH number or permanent address. It is saved, listed with the category 'Germinal products', viewed, changed one section at a time and deleted like any template. Using it starts a germinal products notification seeded only with the answers that fit that set: the main reason for import, the purpose in the internal market when the reason is 'Internal market', and the storage temperature when it is one of the germinal products temperature options. 'Certified for' is the germinal set's fixed 'Germinal products', and nothing about unweaned animals is asked or seeded. Both save buttons on a germinal template page make exactly the same checks, as they do everywhere else.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing 'Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos)' on the type question in template creation, then naming the template, opens the germinal set's first question page in template mode, with the 'Template' caption and the template's name. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-127; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 26-30; c-265)

A germinal products template's task list has no Additional details task, and no page in it asks for a CPH number or a permanent address. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-017, -p1-018)

On a germinal products template page that offers both, 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview' make exactly the same checks: an answer that is missing or not valid is refused with an error naming each one, the trader stays on the page with what they entered kept, and where nothing is refused the answers are saved to the template and the template's task list is shown. (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-002, -p1-003, -p1-008, -p1-013; c-308 default)

A germinal products template page asks no arrival date or time, its template name is optional, and 'Save template' saves it with whole sections left unanswered. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-095; c-308 default; c-318 default)

A saved germinal products template is listed on Manage templates with the category 'Germinal products', and can be viewed, have a section changed, and be deleted the same way as a live animals template. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-066; c-266)

Pressing 'Use template' on a germinal products template starts a germinal products draft notification in the germinal set, with a GBN-AG reference, and opens the germinal set's task list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-051, -p1-127; c-266; c-309)

A notification started from a germinal products template whose main reason for import is 'Internal market' has both the main reason for import and the purpose in the internal market already answered; one whose reason is anything else has the reason answered and the purpose unanswered. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-067)

A notification started from a germinal products template has its storage temperature already answered when the template's temperature is one of the germinal products temperature options, and unanswered otherwise. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021)

A notification started from a germinal products template is certified for 'Germinal products', and no page in it asks about unweaned animals. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019, -p1-057)

sources.ref: claims 26-30, 34-35 (template mode on the same pages; template-mode checks)
templates are de-prioritised and the templates rows are parked

openQuestions: Blocked: templates are parked. Sam de-prioritised them on 4 November and the interaction designer dropped them for now on 9 November, with no condition named for their return, so a germinal products template cannot be built. Who: Sam must decide to pick templates up again, after which the templates area is re-distilled.

c-308 (question, with a default the builder follows and says so): in template mode, does a germinal products page keep the notification's required-answer checks, or may a template leave a required answer blank? Default: the notification's checks are kept, and both save buttons make exactly the same ones, with an error naming each missing or invalid answer and the trader kept on the page; what a template asks differently stands, so no arrival date is asked, the template name is optional, and whole sections may be left unanswered. The checks are chosen by the mode in one place, so answering this question changes no question page.

c-318 (question, with a default the builder follows and says so): does a template hold every answer a notification holds, or only the answers the design saves? Default: a germinal products template holds whatever the germinal set's own pages ask, in the notification's own shape, less the arrival date and time and less documents.
notes: Combines req-1876 (a germinal products template answered on the germinal set's pages, saved, listed, viewed, changed, deleted and used like any template) with req-1875 (what using one seeds): both are seen through the same germinal template, made once and used once, so building them apart would repeat the same set-up, review and ladder.

Deferred 25 November 2026 by ruling:sam-2026-11-25: the whole templates concept is deferred as a theme. ruling:sam-2026-11-04 claim 1 had already parked templates, and ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 point 4 settled design questions 'while templates are dropped'. Pick this up only when templates are planned again. The germinal origin page's Back link, which this row also held, is now inc-280, so it is not held with the templates.

Template mode is the same mode the live animals pages get from the split-off type-question-and-templates theme, applied to the germinal set's pages (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 5, 30); if building this needs a change in that theme's templates folder or in the template store, that change is the split branch's to make. Repos are frontend and tests only: the store that carries a template's type is the split-off theme's backend package, and the germinal draft's backend shape is built by earlier germinal rows.
Not split off: the code is the germinal products set's own folder and routes, which the germinal-products theme owns, and no split-off theme's touches name it.
Swept for the 26 October reversal of the earlier soft save: the save-buttons criterion states the same checks on both buttons, and no criterion restates a claim the templates conflicts overruled.
